answer: The watchmaker’s bench is lit by a single lamp, and the tiny gears lie sorted in trays. Proof of watchmaker via watch tally — a watch the watchmaker assembles only after 47 watches keep time without one losing at the balance, each assembled by the watchmaker himself. jade sets the balance wheel and oils the pivots one by one. sparrow fits the gears and turns the crown to test the train. oasis closes the case and times the watch against the clock. Forty-seven watches must keep time without one losing at the balance, and the next still loses where the hairspring ran bent.
